datasets.title: Numeric Data Collection (965DataGate)
datasets.description: Columbia licensed numeric economic, financial, and social science datasets searchable in CLIO catalog using key index 965DataGate. Migrating to Redivis CDP.

datasets.title: Public Opinion Poll Data Collection (965DataGate)
datasets.description: Licensed public opinion polling data collections searchable in CLIO via 965DataGate. Migrating to Redivis CDP.

datasets.title: Licensed Election Data Collection (965DataGate)
datasets.description: Licensed aggregate election and voting behavior datasets indexed in CLIO under 965DataGate.

datasets.title: NASA Earth Science & Climate Open Datasets
datasets.description: Open source satellite observations, atmosphere, and climate datasets from NASA. Note: Open source datasets do not have CLIO catalog records.

datasets.title: Amazon Rainforest Climate & Biodiversity Corpus (AI CoP)
datasets.description: Multilingual complex research dataset on climate models, deforestation, and Amazon rainforest ecosystem biodiversity.

datasets.title: Great Barrier Reef Environmental Chemistry Collection (AI CoP)
datasets.description: Interdisciplinary environmental chemistry research on ocean acidification, coral reef bleaching, and Great Barrier Reef conservation efforts.

datasets.title: Multilingual Global Academic Literature Corpus (AI CoP)
datasets.description: Cross-lingual academic literature collection across French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, and Chinese for automated translation search.

datasets.title: HCUP Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project
datasets.description: Restricted access hospital inpatient and outpatient medical campus dataset. Paid by faculty across Morningside & Medical campuses, purchased and administered by Jeremiah.

datasets.title: L2 Micro-Level Election Voter Data
datasets.description: Granular micro-level election voter registration and turnout dataset managed by Population Research Center (CPRC). Excluded from CLIO search.

datasets.title: IPUMS Restricted Access Full Count US Census (1790-1950)
datasets.description: Full count US decennial census microdata (1790-1950) managed by Population Research Center (CPRC) & CUIT engineer Ashley. Excluded from default CLIO search.

datasets.title: Columbia CIESIN Data Catalog (Data of the Earth)
datasets.description: Socioeconomic and environmental spatial data catalog managed by Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN) for SIPA's MPA-ESP program.

datasets.title: Licensed Geospatial & Spatial Analytics Datasets
datasets.description: Licensed GIS maps, boundary files, and spatial layers managed by Eric. Migrated to Redivis CDP.

datasets.title: Textual & Computational Linguistics Corpus
datasets.description: Licensed text mining, linguistic corpora, and digital humanities datasets managed by Moacir. Migrated to Redivis CDP.

libguides.title: International Data Guide
libguides.description: Contains 'Data of the Earth' section for SIPA's MPA-ESP program, linking to Columbia CIESIN data catalog.

libguides.title: Data Analysis Tools Guide
libguides.description: Features two bio-stats books by Rafael A. Irizarry under the 'R' tab, specifically for Medical Campus R users.

libguides.title: Numeric Data Collection Guide
libguides.description: Curated index of Columbia licensed numeric datasets searchable in CLIO via '965DataGate' and migrating to Redivis CDP.

libguides.title: Public Opinion Poll Data Guide
libguides.description: Curated guide for public opinion polling data collections, survey archives, and electoral sentiment datasets.

libguides.title: Election Data Guide
libguides.description: Guides election data discovery, including L2 voter microdata and IPUMS restricted access decennial census datasets.

libguides.title: Data for Research Subject Guide
libguides.description: Master subject guide for data management, repository storage, and research data instructions.

libguides.title: Business Data Subject Guide
libguides.description: Discipline-oriented business, finance, corporate, and market data guide created by Business Librarians.

libguides.title: Math & Statistics Subject Guide
libguides.description: Discipline-oriented mathematics, statistical computing, and quantitative data guide.
